The 19:53 rewrite of README.md left two blank lines in a row (lines 25-26, confirmed with cat -vet). Prettier's markdown formatter collapses repeated blank lines to one. Review3 said prettier --check passed, but README.md was changed after that. This conclusion comes from Prettier's formatting rules; prettier was not run, as this review was told not to run checks.
